name: Parent and Director Notification of Seclusion
description: Notice of each use of seclusion; a written report of the seclusion must be completed within one working day and kept in the student's file.
recipient: Parent / guardian; Director of Special Education
deadline: as soon as reasonably possible, no more than 24 hours after the seclusion
quote: The building administrator must notify the parent/guardian of the secluded student and the Director of Special Education as soon as reasonably possible, but in no event more than 24-hours after the use of seclusion with their child.
